scope: Small harbour-side district bbox. Retains above-ground building/part footprints, actual parks/gardens/grass, individual trees, pedestrian paths and retaining walls. Existing source geometry is preserved by element ID. Raw road geometry is not imported. Underground structures are not authored as above-ground houses.
model_limit: OSM heights are retained where tagged; untagged facade heights remain original conservative reconstruction. Retaining wall heights use real ground and adjacent unchanged road planes, not a guessed landscape elevation.
preservation: Existing IDs across buildings, circuit and environment datasets are preserved exactly; only genuinely new semantic elements are merged.
